name: Reslice ROIs to match input anatomy
summary: Reslices a set of ROI volumes onto the voxel grid of a T1-weighted image with FreeSurfer mri_vol2vol (header registration, nearest-neighbour interpolation).
description: Each ROI NIfTI in the input ROIs directory is resampled to the voxel size and spacing of the T1w image using mri_vol2vol --regheader with nearest-neighbour interpolation. Use it when ROIs were generated on a different voxel grid but are already in the same space as the T1w image; it does not register images, so ROIs in another space must be transformed first.

inputs.description: T1-weighted image whose voxel grid is the reslicing target.
inputs.requirements: Must already be aligned (same world space) with the ROIs; only the header geometry is used.

inputs.description: Directory of ROI NIfTI volumes to reslice.

outputs.description: ROI volumes resliced to the T1w voxel grid, one file per input ROI.

citations.text: Dale AM, Fischl B, Sereno MI. Cortical surface-based analysis. I. Segmentation and surface reconstruction. NeuroImage 9:179-194 (1999).
